titulo: Build without coding: you choose, the agent builds, the test confirms
lead: You don't write code. You pick the ingredients on a page, like in a grocery store, export a list, and ask Claude Code or Codex to build it, following the INTELECTO build plan. Then you prove it with the tests and a conversation in the terminal, before connecting it to Telegram.
objetivo: generate the briefing at the grocery store, ask the coding agent to build it with tests, and prove the core with the tests and a conversation.

aprende.t: The grocery store and the meu-assistente.md briefing
Why the list alone isn't enough: the build plan
The build request in one sentence
Prove it with the tests and the conversation in the terminal

hero_alt: Laptop with a dark terminal showing a list of tests with green checkmarks and hands on the keyboard.

secoes.sub: Click each block. The heavy lifting is the agent's.

nos.detalhe: An INTELECTO page with features taken from open projects like OpenClaw, NanoBot, and Hermes, laid out in aisles. Each card explains in one sentence what it does. You click and it goes into the cart.

The export button downloads meu-assistente.md: each ingredient, who already implements it, and where the reference code is. It is the shopping list; the recipe is the plan doc/intelecto.md, with the contracts for each piece.

In the repository folder, with the briefing alongside, you open the agent and ask it to build with tests. It reads, plans, writes piece by piece, and asks for approval to run things. You check what you asked for and the result.

In the exemplo-jarvis, one command runs the nine tests: memory saves, searches, and forgets; the loop asks for a tool and replies; the blocklist stops the dangerous command. Then, a chat in the terminal with a test model, with no internet and no key.

itens.t: Token and key in the vault

nos.detalhe: With the tests green, you swap the test model for a real one (lesson 6) and connect the Telegram channel with the token from lesson 3. The plan tells the agent to build a setup assistant that asks for the token, model, name, and personality.

secoes.legenda: Start small: a few ingredients, tests passing, then grow. You can go back to the grocery store and add more.

secoes.titulo: Each step, with what to check

texto: For a first Jarvis, the installation video chose eight: personality file, Telegram bot, WhatsApp, memory with SQLite search, encrypted secrets vault, forbidden-commands list, scheduling, and skills.
You can start with fewer: personality, Telegram, memory, and vault.

exemplo.texto: The cart has 4 to 8 items and you can say what each one is for.

texto: Export as a briefing for Claude Code and download meu-assistente.md. Clone the INTELECTO repository and put the briefing inside the folder.
What the tests revealed: the list alone is not enough. What makes the build succeed is the pointer to doc/intelecto.md.

exemplo.texto: intelecto/ with doc/intelecto.md, reference-repos/ and your meu-assistente.md.

texto: First ask for the plan: the agent reads everything and returns files, order, and questions (Docker or direct install? OpenRouter or Ollama? which model?). Answer in Portuguese.
With the plan approved, ask for the build with tests. Approve each command it wants to run only when you understand what it is.

exemplo.texto: Describe the problem in Portuguese and ask it to fix it. This cycle is normal and expected.

texto: Run the tests. Then chat in the terminal: "remember that my name is ...", and right after, "what is my name?".
The last line of the example shows the name saved in the database: proof that it is not hard-coded text, and that the memory and the loop work together.

exemplo.texto: All tests pass and the name appears on the DB line.

secoes.sub: Run in the terminal, in the projects folder.

blocos.conteudo:
git clone https://github.com/inematds/intelecto.git
cd intelecto
# copy the meu-assistente.md that the mercearia downloaded into here

Read meu-assistente.md and the plan in doc/intelecto.md. Before writing any code, give me the plan back: files, order, and the decisions that depend on me. Use my identity (SOUL, AGENTS, USER and MEMORY that are in workspace/).

Plan approved. Build my assistant in Python, with tests, following the contracts in doc/intelecto.md. The Telegram bot answers only to my user. Secrets never in the code. When you finish, run the tests and show me the result.

cd exemplo-jarvis
python3 -m unittest discover -s . -p 'test_*.py' -v
python3 smoke.py

abas.html:
USER : lembre que meu nome é Nei
JARVIS: Seu nome é Nei.
USER : qual meu nome?
JARVIS: Seu nome é Nei.
DB   : ['Meu nome é Nei']

The DB line proves the name was saved in SQLite, not pulled from fixed text.

• Memory: save → search → forget.
  • One full round of the loop: the test model asks for a tool, the loop runs it and replies.
  • The blocklist stops the dangerous command and lets the safe one through.
  • Settings go out and come back without losing anything.
  • The context contains the SOUL and the USER.

secoes.sub: Exercise E3 of sequence 2, on the path the repository actually uses.

exercicios.texto: Clone INTELECTO, go into exemplo-jarvis, and run the tests and smoke.py.
exercicios.pronto: the 9 tests pass and the smoke shows the DB line with the name.

exercicios.texto: In the mercearia, check 4 to 8 ingredients and export meu-assistente.md to the INTELECTO folder.
exercicios.pronto: the file is in the folder and each ingredient has its reason noted in your meu-jarvis.md.

exercicios.texto: Copy your workspace/ folder from lesson 2 into the project, make requests 1 and 2, and follow the agent.
exercicios.pronto: the tests pass and, in the conversation in the terminal, it answers with the name and the style you defined.

secoes.fonte: In the original exercise the step is ./start.sh. In today's repository the path is this: briefing + plan + agent builds. The setup assistant is one of the pieces the plan tells it to build.

secoes.sub: From the mercearia to the assistant answering, with the whole path on screen.
The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: Why give the agent meu-assistente.md together with doc/intelecto.md?
opcoes: You don't need to: the briefing is enough.
Because the agent doesn't read .md files on its own.
Because doc/intelecto.md has the Telegram password.
Because the briefing is the shopping list and the plan is the recipe, with the contracts that make each piece fit.
perguntas.explica: The example's validation found this: the briefing alone is a router, not a recipe. The plan's contracts make each piece implementable.

perguntas.p: The agent finished and said "done". What is the proof that it works?
opcoes: The tests passing and the conversation in the terminal saving and remembering a fact in the database.
perguntas.explica: You don't need to understand every line; you need the test. The smoke's DB line shows the fact was really saved.

perguntas.p: What is the right way to start?
opcoes: Write the code by hand first.
A few ingredients, tests passing, then grow.
Start with the server in the cloud.
perguntas.explica: Start small. The mercearia lets you come back and add more; what you can't do is debug 40 pieces at the same time.
